needed.evidence: The footway on the right side is an informal path under 1m wide, partially blocked by objects.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk of at least 1m width along the right side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The informal path under 1m is partly blocked by objects and debris.
needed.suggestion: Clear and maintain the walking path free from obstructions to ensure accessibility and safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections in the informal path are posing trip hazards for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Repair the uneven sections of the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: There is a demand for pedestrian crossing due to mixed land use and visible pedestrian activity, but there is no purpose-built crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing or a raised platform crossing at this location to enable safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Street lighting is insufficient along this urban road, particularly in areas where pedestrians are visible.
needed.suggestion: Install adequate street lighting along this stretch of the road to ensure visibility and safety for pedestrians and road users during nighttime.
